title: Equation for a Returned Split
statement: Let $N$ and $i$ be natural numbers. If the split solver with parameters $C=1$ and $e=1$ at total length $N$ returns $i$, then $i+(i+1)=N$.
hypotheses_covered: The split solver with parameters $C=1$ and $e=1$ at total length $N$ returns $i$
replaced:
If the certificate-split solver with parameters $(1,1)$, searching for a split of a
total length $N$, returns the value $i$, then $i + (i + 1) = N$.
